title: Coequalizer
description: JSON Schema for a coequalizer — the universal cocone over a parallel pair (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3; Awodey 2010 §5.4). Dual to equalizer. Given f, g : A → B, the coequalizer is an object C with a morphism c : B → C such that c ∘ f = c ∘ g, universal in this property.

parallel-pair.description: The parallel pair f, g : A → B.

coequalizing-morphism.description: The morphism c : B → C satisfying c ∘ f = c ∘ g.

coequalizer-object.description: The coequalizer object C — the quotient of B identifying f's and g's images.
